skill.name: nano-banana-blockrun
skill.description: Generate images through BlockRun's x402 API using Nano Banana, Nano Banana Pro, or DALL-E 3. The skill uses USDC micropayments on Base and requires a configured wallet key.
skill.summary: Generate AI images with BlockRun x402 micropayments on Base.
skill.author: BlockRunAI

security_audit.summary: The audit found no prompt injection text, but the skill has real high-impact secret and payment risks. Several static hits were Markdown or license false positives, while private-key setup, .env usage, external SDK execution, and paid BlockRun API calls remain confirmed concerns.

remediation.issue: The skill requires users to configure a raw wallet private key.
remediation.suggestion: Support a safer wallet flow, hardware signing, delegated keys, or a dedicated low-balance wallet with documented spend limits.

remediation.issue: Paid image generation can be triggered through natural language requests.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user confirmation before each paid request and display model, price, network, and wallet balance impact.

remediation.issue: The setup installs blockrun-llm without pinning or verification.
remediation.suggestion: Pin a reviewed package version and document hash verification or a trusted lockfile for the payment SDK.

remediation.issue: The documentation references scripts/generate.py, but the script is absent from scanned files.
remediation.suggestion: Add the referenced script or remove the command examples so users do not run unverifiable paths.

content.user_title: Generate Paid AI Images with BlockRun
content.value_statement: Image generation often needs API keys, subscriptions, or manual payment setup. This skill routes prompts through BlockRun and pays per request with USDC on Base.
actual_capabilities: Provides setup steps for the blockrun-llm Python SDK.
Shows a Python example that calls ImageClient.generate with a text prompt.
Lists supported image models with approximate prices and resolutions.
Explains the x402 payment flow, including local EIP-712 signing.
limitations: Requires USDC on Base and a configured EVM wallet private key.
Uses the external BlockRun API and may incur a charge for each request.
The referenced scripts/generate.py file is not present in the scanned files.
Does not document spend limits, per-request confirmations, or key isolation controls.

use_cases.title: Create concept images
use_cases.description: Generate draft visuals from short creative prompts for review or iteration.

use_cases.title: Prototype paid AI media flows
use_cases.description: Test x402 image generation patterns inside Claude Code or Codex-assisted workflows.

use_cases.title: Produce campaign drafts
use_cases.description: Create image options with clear per-request pricing before selecting final assets.

prompt_templates.title: Generate a simple image
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request with one prompt and the default model.
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate an image of a modern desk setup with plants, soft daylight, and a clean background.

prompt_templates.title: Choose a model first
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request that asks for model and price context before generation.
prompt_templates.prompt: Before generating, tell me the available image models and approximate cost. Then create a detailed cyberpunk street scene.

prompt_templates.title: Create branded visual options
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced creative request with style constraints and multiple directions.
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate two visual directions for a fintech product banner. Use a professional style, no logos, and a bright city background.

prompt_templates.title: Confirm payment-sensitive settings
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request that asks for confirmation before a paid generation call.
prompt_templates.prompt: Confirm the model, estimated price, Base network, and wallet readiness before generating a 4K product hero image.

output_examples.input: Generate an image of a sunset over mountains.
output_examples.output: The assistant returns a generated image link, the model used, and the approximate USDC charge.

output_examples.input: Create a futuristic city image with higher quality settings.
output_examples.output: The assistant selects a higher quality model, summarizes the prompt, and provides the resulting image location.

output_examples.input: Explain what will happen before generating an image.
output_examples.output: The assistant describes the BlockRun API call, local payment signing, and expected pay-per-request cost.

best_practices: Use a dedicated wallet with a small USDC balance for image generation.
Ask for model, estimated price, and network confirmation before each paid request.
Keep wallet keys out of shared workspaces, logs, prompts, and screenshots.
anti_patterns: Do not use a wallet that holds unrelated funds or high balances.
Do not let an agent run repeated generations without explicit spending limits.
Do not paste private keys into chat messages, issue trackers, or generated files.

faq.question: Does this skill need an API key?
faq.answer: No. It uses USDC payments on Base through the x402 flow instead of a standard API key.

faq.question: What wallet information is required?
faq.answer: The setup expects an EVM private key in BLOCKRUN_WALLET_KEY. Use a dedicated low-balance wallet.

faq.question: Will my private key be sent to BlockRun?
faq.answer: The documentation says signing happens locally and only a payment signature is sent.

faq.question: Can this spend money automatically?
faq.answer: Yes. Image generation is pay per request, so use confirmations and a small wallet balance.

faq.question: Which models are documented?
faq.answer: The skill documents Nano Banana, Nano Banana Pro, and DALL-E 3 with approximate prices.

faq.question: Does the repository include the helper script?
faq.answer: No evidence found in the scanned files for the referenced scripts/generate.py helper script.
